Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting user files with RSA public key (1024 bit)
Pretends to be from Proton Technologies security team
Uses ransom note claiming victim's data was encrypted by Proton's SECURE-SERVER service during an outsider attack
Threatens data loss if other decryption tools are used
Impacted Systems: Users with encrypted files submitted to ID-Ransomware
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to file encryption
Social engineering via fake ransom note impersonating Proton security
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text containing 'PROTON SECURE-SERVER SYSTEMS (c) 2019'
